formula_description: geoMean(q, d, p) = (q/10)^W_q * (d/10)^W_d * (p/10)^W_p * 10, where axis scores are 0-10 scale. Display score = Math.round(geoMean * 10). Minimum axis input clamped to 0.01 before normalization.

axis_stretch.notes: No axis stretch in v1.0. Enable when 10+ products scored to compute real category ranges.

calibration_products.name: Marvin Signature Ultimate Entry Door
calibration_products.notes: Tier 1 anchor. Architect default for $2-5M homes. Engineered laminated wood/hybrid slabs (most warp-resistant). Premium factory-integrated hardware, multi-point lock standard. Lifetime warranty backed by Fortune Brands (NYSE: FBIN). Installers praise warp resistance in humid climates. High-end IGUs with low-E, refinishable UV-stable stains (10+ year durability). Unlimited custom options, 12-16 week lead time.

calibration_products.name: Therma-Tru Classic-Craft Premium (Fiberglass)
calibration_products.notes: Tier 1 lower anchor. AccuGrain compression-molded fiberglass (most realistic grain in fiberglass). Rot-proof slab — inherent material advantage. Polyurethane foam core (R-5+). Multi-point lock system. 50-year/lifetime warranty. Installers note easy service, excellent energy efficiency. <1% service calls reported by pros. Fortune Brands (parent of Therma-Tru). Contractor consensus: best fiberglass door available.

calibration_products.name: Pella Reserve Entry Door
calibration_products.notes: Tier 2 anchor. #1 consumer trust (LifeStory Research). Wood/fiberglass hybrid, strong sealing system (R6+ rated), good but not best-in-class construction. Better than JELD-WEN but below ProVia/Therma-Tru Classic-Craft per professional consensus. Family-owned (Pella Corporation). Limited lifetime warranty. Semi-custom options, 8-12 week lead time. Not specified for ultra-premium homes but reliable choice for $1-3M range.

calibration_products.name: Therma-Tru Benchmark Entry (Fiberglass)
calibration_products.notes: Tier 3 anchor (quality floor). Builder line of Therma-Tru. Thinner compression molding than Classic-Craft, less realistic grain, higher delamination risk. Still Fortune Brands warranty. Standard weatherstripping (not multi-layer). Single deadbolt standard. Professional quality floor: pros install Benchmark in $500K+ homes without hesitation but prefer Classic-Craft. Widely available through dealers and some big-box.

calibration_products.name: Masonite Performance Door System (Fiberglass)
calibration_products.notes: Tier 3 lower. Solid mid-market — innovative weatherstrip edges out JELD-WEN. Comparable to Therma-Tru Benchmark but better seals, slightly less brand recognition. Masonite International (public). Fewer water intrusion issues than steel alternatives. Hardware quality adequate but not premium. Minor finish fade after 7-10 years.

calibration_products.name: JELD-WEN Builders Series (Steel/Fiberglass)
calibration_products.notes: Tier 4 upper. Builder-grade entry. 22-24 gauge steel warps in sun. AuraLast wood reputation hit carries over (windows worse than doors, but brand damage persists). Mexico-made lines cheaper and thinner. Improved post-2020 but contractor wariness remains. Water intrusion at corners (poor welds) documented. High callback rate for Builders Series. JELD-WEN (public, NYSE: JELD).

calibration_products.name: Reliabilt Entry Door (Lowe's)
calibration_products.notes: Tier 4 lower / borderline Tier 5. JELD-WEN-made big-box exclusive for Lowe's — downgraded specs (24-26 gauge steel, thin fiberglass). 50%+ service call rate per contractor consensus. Pros refuse for quality homes. Expected 5-8 year lifespan. Weatherstrip fails at 2-5 years, warping common in steel models, delamination in fiberglass models at 3-7 years. Highest callbacks in category.
